title: Artifact Registry: repositories, immutable tags and vulnerability scanning

videos.script: The build made an image. Now it needs somewhere to wait. {{image}} That place is Artifact Registry. A repository has a format, a region and a name, and none of them can change. {{repository}} Then the part that bites. A tag is a label, and pushing again moves it. Nothing warns you. A rollback to version one can quietly be a roll forward. {{tag}} A digest is different. It is the image's own fingerprint, and it cannot point anywhere else. So deployments name digests. {{digest}} Last, what is inside the image. Scanning finds known vulnerabilities in its packages. It writes a report, and refuses nothing. {{scan}} By the end, you will push to a registry on your own computer, watch a tag move, and pull the old image back by its digest. {{end}}
